segments.title: Never re-explain yourself to AI
segments.say: Long chats make AI worse. Part two: never re-explain yourself again.

segments.title: Ask for a handoff note
segments.say: Before a chat gets long, ask for a handoff note.
Type: write a handoff note with my goal, rules and decisions.
You get a short note you can carry anywhere.
segments.text: Goal: launch email. Rules: short, friendly. Decided: send Tuesday.

segments.title: Then in a new chat
segments.say: Paste it into a fresh chat. Save your standing rules in settings, and keep one topic per chat.
Save this for your next long project, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
